assets.label: 地质与物探
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: premium petroleum education website theme banner, landscape roughly 2:1. Primary request: an elegant editorial landscape painting of geological exploration. Scene: broad arid sandstone terrain with beautiful stratified and gently folded outcrops in the foreground and midground, an open plain, a small unbranded exploration truck far in the distance, blue-gray mountains fading into a spacious pale sky. Style: refined industrial editorial illustration, finely painted natural textures and subtle atmospheric depth, confident and restrained, high visual quality. Composition: panoramic, clear focal sandstone formation toward the right, generous quiet pale sky and open land on the left for later webpage copy. Lighting: soft early morning light, calm and airy, no harsh glare. Color palette: deep ink teal, warm sand gold, muted slate blue and warm off-white, delicate tonal transitions. Constraints: no people, no text, no numbers, no labels, no charts, no logos, no watermark; no neon, no cyberpunk, no fantasy machines, no disaster, no black smoke. This is website theme art, not a technical operating diagram.

generationEdit.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the supplied oilfield sunset illustration. Make one small localized correction only: remove the pale rectangular label/plaque and all letter-like markings from the nearest large pumpjack's upper horizontal beam. Fill that spot seamlessly with the same plain dark teal painted steel, including its existing light, texture and perspective. Preserve the entire composition, three pumpjacks, all equipment geometry, sunset, mountains, colors, lighting, ground, shadows, detail, framing and aspect ratio.
